entities.name: CAG information list
entities.description: An information element that may be included to assign a new CAG information list to the UE or delete the CAG information list at the UE side.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that receives and stores the CAG information list.

entities.name: Assign CAG information list
entities.description: Condition where a new CAG information list is provided to the UE.

entities.name: Delete CAG information list
entities.description: Condition where the CAG information list is deleted at the UE side.

relations.description: The CAG information list IE can be used to assign a new list to the UE.
The CAG information list IE can be used to delete the list at the UE side.
Assigning a new CAG information list establishes the UE's stored CAG information.
Deleting the CAG information list establishes that the UE no longer has a stored CAG information list.
